# GUI Interface Description

## Operating System and Desktop Environment
- **Operating System**: Linux (based on desktop environment and application icons)
- **Desktop Environment**: GNOME (indicated by the top bar, application dock, and system icons)
- **Top Bar**: 
  - Left: "Activities" button
  - Center: "Google Chrome" application title
  - Right: System status icons (including date and time, notification bell, and system controls)

## Application Windows
### Google Chrome Browser Window
- **Browser Tabs**:
  - "5G towers conspiracy"
  - "Conspiracy theorists b"
  - "Chrome Web Store - E"
  - Plus sign for new tab
- **Browser Address Bar**:
  - URL: `chromewebstore.google.com/category/extensions?hl=en-GB`
  - Search bar with placeholder text: "Search extensions and themes"
- **Browser Navigation**:
  - Back and forward arrows
  - Refresh button
  - Star icon for bookmarking
  - User profile icon
  - "Relaunch to update" button
- **Chrome Web Store Content**:
  - **Navigation Tabs**: "Discover", "Extensions" (selected), "Themes"
  - **Left Sidebar Menu**:
    - "Productivity"
    - "Communication"
    - "Developer Tools"
    - "Education"
    - "Tools"
    - "Workflow and planning"
    - "Lifestyle"
    - "Art & Design"
    - "Entertainment"
    - "Games"
    - "Household"
  - **Main Content Area**:
    - **Section 1**: "Favourites of 2025" with description "Discover the standout AI extensions that made our year" and a "See collection" button
    - **Section 2**: "Recommended for you" with preview cards for extensions (e.g., a blue car, a Mario-themed extension, and an "Offline Games" collection)

### GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP) Window
- **Title Bar**: "GNU Image Manipulation Program"
- **Top Menu Bar**:
  - "File", "Edit", "Select", "View", "Image", "Layer", "Colors", "Tools", "Filters", "Windows", "Help"
- **Left Sidebar (Toolbox)**:
  - **Tool Icons**:
    - Selection tools (e.g., rectangular, elliptical, free-form)
    - Drawing tools (e.g., pencil, brush, eraser)
